headline: MPE Partners and Intermatic Acquire Sunrise Technologies
summary: Private equity firm MPE Partners and its portfolio company Intermatic have completed the acquisition of Raynham-based Sunrise Technologies. The deal integrates the Massachusetts-based company into Intermatic's existing operations.
why: MPE Partners is a private equity firm that manages investments in lower middle-market companies, while Intermatic is a manufacturer of energy management and lighting control solutions.

impacts.name: Intermatic LLC
impacts.why: The acquisition expands the company's portfolio and operational footprint.
